meta.og_title: Residential plots on the Indore–Ujjain Road | Valencia Town
meta.description: Residential plots of 1,000–2,400 sq ft on the Indore–Ujjain Road at Shahna: a 48-acre gated township, 25 min from Indore Airport and 40 min from Ujjain.

image: Wide, tree-lined internal road at Valencia Town, artist’s impression
pages.h1: Residential plots on the Indore–Ujjain Road
pages.intro: Valencia Town is a {acres}-acre gated township of residential plots at Shahna, on the Indore–Ujjain Road. Indore’s hospitals, schools and airport are on one side; Ujjain and Shri Mahakaleshwar are on the other.
sections: Why buyers look at this road

The Indore–Ujjain Road joins Madhya Pradesh’s largest city with one of India’s great pilgrim towns. From Valencia Town, Sri Aurobindo Hospital is about {saims} minutes away, Vijay Nagar and Indore Airport about {vijay} minutes, and Ujjain about {ujjain} minutes.

The 46 km road is being widened to six lanes, with a reported target of December 2026, ahead of Simhastha in Ujjain in 2028. Godrej Properties has also launched Godrej Greenview Estate, about 46 acres of plots on the same road. Valencia Town is an independent project and is not affiliated with Godrej.
What Valencia Town offers here

1,000+ residential plots of approximately 1,000–2,400 sq ft, planned as one township with a clubhouse, a temple, forest-style gardens, sports courts, children’s play areas, landscaped lawns and wide internal roads behind a gated entrance.
Sizes are approximate and availability changes, so ask the team which plots are open today and for the current price list.
What to check before you buy a plot on this road

Many plotted projects are selling on the Indore–Ujjain Road. Whichever you consider, check the MP RERA registration on the RERA portal, the town and country planning (T&CP) layout approval, clear title in the seller’s name, the plot’s dimensions against the approved layout, the width of the road in front of the plot, and whether banks finance plots in that layout.
Ask the Valencia Town team for these documents during your visit; the developer, approvals and project documents are also listed on the homepage.
faq: Where on the Indore–Ujjain Road is Valencia Town?
At Shahna, between Indore and Ujjain in Madhya Pradesh. Use “Get directions” in the footer to open the location in Google Maps.
Is the Indore–Ujjain Road being widened?
Yes. The 46 km road is being widened to six lanes, with a reported target of December 2026 (The Times of India, January 2025).
What should I check before buying a plot on the Indore–Ujjain Road?

The MP RERA registration, the T&CP layout approval, clear title, the plot’s dimensions against the approved layout, the road width in front of the plot, and whether banks finance plots in that layout.
Can I visit the plots on a weekend?
Yes. Visits are by appointment, 10 am – 7 pm, every day. Use “Book a site visit” and the team will call to fix a time.

pages.h1: Plots near Ujjain, forty minutes from Mahakaleshwar
pages.intro: For many families, a home near Mahakal is the point. Valencia Town is at Shahna on the Indore–Ujjain Road, about {ujjain} minutes by road from Ujjain, home of the Mahakaleshwar Jyotirlinga.
sections: A morning darshan, home by breakfast

The Bhasma Aarti at Shri Mahakaleshwar is held before dawn, around 4 am. From Valencia Town it is a drive of about {ujjain} minutes each way, so a darshan no longer means a journey. Aarti timings and bookings are set by the temple; check its official website before you go.
Shravan Mondays, Mahashivratri and Nag Panchami are within reach every year, not once in a lifetime.
Simhastha 2028

Simhastha, the Kumbh of Ujjain held once in twelve years, takes place in 2028, and the Indore–Ujjain Road widening is timed with it. Any effect on property prices is uncertain; treat it as context, not a promise of returns.
Near Ujjain, with Indore close by

Living between the two cities keeps Indore’s everyday needs near: Sri Aurobindo Hospital about {saims} minutes, Vijay Nagar and Indore Airport about {vijay} minutes. Inside the {acres}-acre township there is a temple of its own, alongside the clubhouse, gardens, sports courts and play areas.
faq: How far is Valencia Town from Mahakaleshwar Temple?
About {ujjain} minutes by road to Ujjain. Drive times vary with traffic, route and festival crowds.
Can I attend the Bhasma Aarti and be home the same morning?
Yes. The aarti is held before dawn and the drive is about {ujjain} minutes each way. Timings and bookings are set by the temple, so check its official website first.
Is there a temple inside Valencia Town?
Yes. The masterplan includes a temple, described as a space for reflection woven into the life of the community. Layouts are indicative and subject to change.
When is Simhastha in Ujjain?
In 2028. Simhastha is the Kumbh of Ujjain, held once in twelve years.

pages.intro: Shahna sits on the Indore–Ujjain Road, between Indore and Ujjain. Valencia Town brings {acres} acres of residential plots here, planned as one gated township.
sections: The township, zone by zone

A grand entrance, a clubhouse, a temple, a forest garden, landscaped greens, sports and recreation, residential precincts and wide internal roads. Each is marked on the masterplan on the homepage; positions are indicative.
The township also plans children’s play areas, a senior citizens’ library, and meeting and women’s activity zones.
Choosing a plot size

Plots range from approximately 1,000 to 2,400 sq ft. For scale, a 20 × 30 ft house footprint is 600 sq ft, so even the smallest plots leave room for a garden or parking. Actual dimensions vary by plot; ask for the current layout.
Visiting Shahna
Visits are by appointment, 10 am – 7 pm, every day. Walk the avenues, stand on your plot, then drive on to Ujjain for darshan, about {ujjain} minutes away.
faq: Where is Shahna?
Shahna is on the Indore–Ujjain Road in Madhya Pradesh, between Indore and Ujjain. Indore Airport is about {vijay} minutes from Valencia Town and Ujjain about {ujjain} minutes.
What plot sizes are available in Valencia Town, Shahna?
Approximately 1,000–2,400 sq ft. The sales team can confirm current sizes and availability.
What amenities does the Shahna township have?

A clubhouse, temple, children’s play areas, forest-style gardens, sports courts, landscaped lawns, a senior citizens’ library, meeting and women’s activity zones, wide internal roads and gated security. Specifications are indicative.
How do I get the price list for plots in Shahna?
Use “Get price list & layout” and the team will send the current price list, layout and payment plan.
